final: SELECT si.riskeval, AVG(s.gbsize / s.spanmin) AS avg_file_size_per_scan_minute FROM scans AS s JOIN sites AS si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry WHERE s.chronotag BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' AND s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin != 0 AND si.riskeval IS NOT NULL GROUP BY si.riskeval
